'''Cardiff Met Football Club''' ({{langx|cy|Clwb Pêl-droed Met Caerdydd}}), commonly known as '''Cardiff Met F.C.''', are a Welsh [[association football|football]] club, based in [[Cyncoed]], [[Cardiff]] that plays in the {{Welsh football updater|CarMetU}}. The club badge features the bowman with the words "''I lwyddo, rhaid chwarae''" which is translated as "''To succeed, [one] must play''"."}}
